description: OHLC bars for 79 currency pairs (EURUSD, USDJPY, GBPUSD, AUDUSD, USDCAD, USDCHF, NZDUSD, EURJPY, USDCNH, USDMXN, USDINR, USDBRL, USDTRY, USDZAR and more) since January 2010. interval: 1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 1hour or 1day (default). Times are US Eastern. Clipped to as_of. Free keys get daily bars for the last 12 months; paid keys get every bar size.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

symbol.description: Currency pair, e.g. EURUSD or USDJPY.

name: get_fx
title: Get FX (currency) bars
